dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Well, Uncle Liushi loves to sing from the crow's nest. At first, no one knew who was doing that. Almost thought it was a ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Then there's Aunt Furong. Sometimes, when she's alone, she says the Captain's name over and over, and her face is all red...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, and there's Aunt Yinxing, who really loves animals. You can't take pets on board, so she raises a few fish in her cups...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: ...So there was this one time when Uncle Sea Drake got dead drunk, and he drank her fish with his grog. Till today, she has no clue how they went missing...
